'''Switch''', also known by the number '''CP-6824''', was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Private/Legends|private]] serving in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
[[File:CP-6824.jpg|thumb|left|120px|Switch]]
Private Switch was a "soft-shell"&mdash;a clone trained for technical tasks rather than combat. He proved his resourcefulness and bravery during the [[Battle of Juma 9]]. The station [[Juma 9]] was attacked by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] army led by [[Kul Teska]], and Switch proved himself invaluable to [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] by restoring power to the station's critical systems, which allowed the clones and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to defend the station against the assault. The CIS forces were much greater in numbers, however, and soon the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] was forced into retreat. When the station came under threat of being utterly destroyed, the Jedi ordered all [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to abandon station. Switch and [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] escorted many of their brothers into [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] and boarded the last one themselves. However, the pod was damaged and required manual activation. Switch chose to sacrifice himself, pushing Cody into the pod and ejecting it from outside, just before the massive explosion shook the station.

The station, however, was badly damaged but not destroyed. Switch survived, but was trapped alone in a deserted area with no means to contact anyone. Sometime later, Republic reinforcements arrived. Jedi Generals [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], accompanied by Commander [[Ponds/Legends|CC-6454]], arrived to find Koon and Kenobi, but instead heard Switch's call for help. Since Switch was in the best position to locate the missing [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]], Windu and Fisto first made their way to his location, and then escorted Switch through the hazards into the main data center, where he discovered the room Koon and Kenobi were trapped in. After the last remaining [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] were destroyed, Switch was present at the meeting of nine Jedi, five of whom were present via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]], and transmitted to them several important recordings, including the conversation between Kul Teska and [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and a plea for help from [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] from [[Behpour/Legends|Behpour]].
